    Local corners are truncated polynomial algebras #

    Lemma 3.1(2) (projective-rays.tex): "Every subspace of rad C/(rad C)² lifts to an ideal, so this space has dimension at most one […]. A lift t of a generator generates successive radical powers, by Nakayama's lemma. Nilpotence then writes every element as a polynomial in t, giving C ≅ k[t]/(t^N)."

    Here the ideals of C = R_x are the endpoint subbimodules of A(x, x), which form a chain (Lemma 3.1(3), isChain_subbimodules); this gives rad C = k t + (rad C)² (exists_rad_gen). Nakayama's lemma for subbimodules gives rad C ⊆ C t C, and Lemma 3.1(3) makes C t C one-sided, C t or t C; so every element is a polynomial in t (aeval_surjective). The kernel of k[X] → C is (X^N) with N the nilpotency index of t.
